name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
description: Adversaries may use brute force techniques to gain access to accounts when passwords are unknown or when password hashes are obtained.
detection: Monitor authentication logs for high volumes of failed logons across multiple accounts or from a single source.
mitigation: Use multi-factor authentication and account lockout policies.

name: Valid Accounts
description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts as a means of gaining Initial Access, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, or Defense Evasion.
detection: Monitor for unusual login times, impossible travel, and atypical access patterns for user accounts.
mitigation: Enforce MFA, least privilege, and strong password policies.

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
description: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution of malicious payloads and system discovery.
detection: Monitor for encoded PowerShell commands, suspicious parent processes, and unusual script block logging.
mitigation: Enable PowerShell logging and constrain execution with application control policies.

name: Remote Services: Remote Desktop Protocol
description: Adversaries may use Valid Accounts to log into a computer using the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP).
detection: Monitor for RDP logons from unusual sources, off-hours activity, and failed authentication spikes on port 3389.
mitigation: Restrict RDP exposure, require MFA for remote access, and use jump hosts.

name: Phishing: Spearphishing Link
description: Adversaries may send spearphishing messages with a malicious link to elicit sensitive information or deliver malware.
detection: Monitor email gateway alerts, suspicious URL clicks, and credential submissions to untrusted domains.
mitigation: Deploy email filtering, user awareness training, and URL rewriting.

name: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Kerberoasting
description: Adversaries may abuse a valid Kerberos ticket-granting ticket to request service tickets for service accounts with SPNs.
detection: Monitor for unusual SPN ticket requests and service account authentication anomalies.
mitigation: Use strong service account passwords and monitor Kerberos ticket requests.

name: Data from Cloud Storage Object
description: Adversaries may access data from cloud storage objects such as S3 buckets or Azure blobs.
detection: Monitor for unusual object access, large downloads, and access from new IP addresses.
mitigation: Apply least-privilege bucket policies and enable cloud audit logging.

name: Email Collection: Email Forwarding Rule
description: Adversaries may setup email forwarding rules to collect sensitive information from a user's mailbox.
detection: Monitor for new inbox rules, forwarding to external addresses, and impossible travel around mailbox changes.
mitigation: Restrict external forwarding and alert on suspicious mailbox rule creation.
